The '''Pod Melter''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] course located on the permanently sunlit "hot side" of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. The course often experienced [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] of 400 degrees or more, meaning that racers were forced to compete to fly in the portions of the course that were shaded.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
